chain_structure.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(chain_json::jsonb)='object') AS object_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE chain_json::jsonb ? 'expiration_count') AS summary_expiration_count_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(chain_json::jsonb->'expirations')='array') AS expiration_array_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE chain_json::jsonb ? 'contracts') AS contract_field_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE chain_json::jsonb ? 'as_of' OR chain_json::jsonb ? 'captured_at' OR chain_json::jsonb ? 'quote_time') AS embedded_quote_timestamp_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE chain_json::jsonb->>'note' LIKE 'summary only%') AS explicitly_summary_only_rows FROM options_chain_snapshots

chain_top_level_keys.sql: SELECT key,count(*) AS row_count FROM options_chain_snapshots CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(chain_json::jsonb)='object' THEN chain_json::jsonb ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS key GROUP BY key ORDER BY key

bar_event_time_coverage.sql: SELECT timeframe,count(*) AS rows,count(DISTINCT symbol) AS distinct_symbols,min(bar_time) AS earliest_bar_time,max(bar_time) AS latest_bar_time,count(*) FILTER (WHERE bar_time>=NOW()-INTERVAL '30 days') AS rows_30d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE bar_time>=NOW()-INTERVAL '60 days') AS rows_60d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE bar_time>=NOW()-INTERVAL '90 days') AS rows_90d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE bar_time>NOW()) AS future_bar_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at>bar_time+INTERVAL '1 day') AS ingested_more_than_day_after_bar FROM market_ohlcv_bars GROUP BY timeframe ORDER BY timeframe

signal_business_date_coverage.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows,min(signal_date) AS earliest_signal_date,max(signal_date) AS latest_signal_date,count(*) FILTER (WHERE signal_date>=CURRENT_DATE-30) AS rows_30d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE signal_date>=CURRENT_DATE-60) AS rows_60d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE signal_date>=CURRENT_DATE-90) AS rows_90d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE signal_date>created_at::date) AS future_business_date_at_initial_ingest,count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at::date>signal_date+1) AS initial_ingest_after_next_day FROM action_signals_history

strategy_fired_time_coverage.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows,count(DISTINCT symbol) AS distinct_symbols,min(fired_at) AS earliest_fired_at,max(fired_at) AS latest_fired_at,count(*) FILTER (WHERE fired_at>=NOW()-INTERVAL '30 days') AS rows_30d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE fired_at>=NOW()-INTERVAL '60 days') AS rows_60d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE fired_at>=NOW()-INTERVAL '90 days') AS rows_90d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE fired_at IS NULL) AS missing_fired_at,count(*) FILTER (WHERE fired_at>NOW()) AS future_fired_at FROM strategy_signals

chain_capture_calendar_coverage.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT captured_at::date) AS captured_calendar_days,min(captured_at) AS first_capture,max(captured_at) AS last_capture,count(*) FILTER (WHERE captured_at>=NOW()-INTERVAL '30 days') AS rows_30d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE captured_at>=NOW()-INTERVAL '60 days') AS rows_60d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE captured_at>=NOW()-INTERVAL '90 days') AS rows_90d FROM options_chain_snapshots
